pages.text: The fire giant with the flaming sword, lord of Muspelheim. He hurls fireballs and kindles a ring of flame around himself.
Enraged, he brings down a rain of fire. Snowballs, water and Mjolnir's lightning hurt him more. Bring fire resistance potions. Drops the Sword of Surtr.
Surtr's heat blunts blades and arrows: they wound him only half as deep. Hold a frost heart, taken from the frost giants, in your other hand and your weapon strikes at full strength.
